review.why: Audit a page for WCAG 2.2 AA with axe-core and pa11y, test by keyboard and screen reader, then fix the violations found.
review.summary: A four-phase workflow: route new UI work elsewhere, run pinned automated audits, complete manual keyboard, screen reader and visual checks, then fix root causes before adding ARIA. A bundled script runs both tools and refuses to report a clean result if either fails. Includes rationalizations, red flags and a verification checklist.
strengths: Treats automated tools as a smoke test and requires manual keyboard and screen reader checks, with a named browser and assistive technology pair.
The audit script pins tool versions, validates each report and never turns a partial run into a clean result.
Fix order is sensible: native HTML first, ARIA as a bridge, then re-test.
cautions: The script downloads pinned @axe-core/cli and pa11y from npm with npx and drives a headless browser against the URL you give it.
Links to a checklist and an auditor persona outside the skill folder (the repository's references and agents folders), which a single-skill install does not include.
SKILL.md and the script were read in full; the script was not run here.
